name: 更好的故障机器人 / Better Defect
author: Codex
description: v103/vPC/v110 compatible full build: restores 26 old Defect cards and adds the Ancient card 偏差认知*改 for Darv's Dusty Tome. Transformed Hyperbeam now follows the official v0.111 rules: 24(30) damage to all enemies and lose 3 Focus only for the current turn. Transformed Hello World allows skipping its three-card choice. Includes the Fission orb visual fix, starter Strike -> Ball Lightning option, 10 historical versions and 66 custom transformations with a persistent 50-point budget. Dynamic reward odds and card disabling live in the standalone DynamicCardOdds mod. No BaseLib.
